description: Four short tasks that are graded on following the stated output format exactly.

tasks.prompt: Reply with the single lowercase word that names the yellow curved fruit monkeys are famous for eating. Put it inside <answer></answer> tags and write nothing else inside the tags.
Return a JSON object with exactly two keys: "name" with the string value "Ada" and "age" with the integer value 36. Put the JSON inside <answer></answer> tags.
Sort these words alphabetically: pear, apple, mango, cherry. Give a JSON array of the sorted words, in order, inside <answer></answer> tags.
Write the integers from 1 to 5 in increasing order, separated by a comma and a single space, inside <answer></answer> tags. Nothing else may be inside the tags.
